req.title: Blog post title required on update
req.statement: The system shall reject POST /<id>/update with a missing title, rendering an error.
triggers: blog post title required on update

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a blog post update must include a title, and the system should reject updates without a title. This is a validation requirement, and the tests are designed to ensure that the system behaves correctly when the title is missing, present, or at boundary conditions.

tests.name: test_update_post_with_title
actions: Send POST request to update the blog post with a valid title
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'user', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'user', 'password': 'pass'})

# Create a post
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Initial Title', 'body': 'Initial Body'})

# Update the post with a valid title
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'Updated Title', 'body': 'Updated Body'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_update_post_without_title
actions: Send POST request to update the blog post without a title
expected: Error message 'Title is required.' is flashed
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'user', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'user', 'password': 'pass'})

# Create a post
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Initial Title', 'body': 'Initial Body'})

# Attempt to update the post without a title
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': '', 'body': 'Updated Body'})
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Title is required.' in r.data

tests.name: test_update_post_title_boundary
actions: Send POST request to update the blog post with a title of length 1
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'user', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'user', 'password': 'pass'})

# Create a post
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Initial Title', 'body': 'Initial Body'})

# Update the post with a boundary title length of 1
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'A', 'body': 'Updated Body'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
